svg.text: HR-grid dual U · PAN is a first-class stream · no matcher / reliability / change prior
global residual on bicubic MS · network only learns the pansharpening residual
SpeGate from native LR MS, not from bicubic skip
Self-scan first, then zero-init 1×1 cross, then mix. Not FusionMamba CrossMambaBlock.
pan = pan + RWKV(Norm(pan)) · ms = ms + Mamba(Norm(ms))
spa = pan + RWKV(Norm(pan + W_P←M(ms))) · spe = ms + Mamba(Norm(ms + W_M←P(pan)))
non-final: ((spa + fused)/2, (spe + fused)/2) final Stage 4: fused only
W_P←M and W_M←P start at 0, so step 0 is two independent self-scans. PanMsFusion never passes a reliability map.
Single-channel spatial detail on the HR grid.
Multi-band spectral stream, bicubic-upsampled to PAN.
Better inductive bias for cross-band mixing.
to_hrms last layer tiny; init ≈ bicubic MS.
No matcher, no ReliabilityField, no change prior.
No CrossMambaBlock — cross is 1×1 then re-scan.
Down: Conv 2×2 s2. Up: ConvTranspose 2×2 + DW mix.
Widths D / 2D / 4D, only Stage 4 collapses to one stream.
DualStreamFusion can take reliability; RDM-PAN does not.
